# E2 trading test: before / after the de-duplicated rest-of-day tables

*Generated by `experiments/restofday_trading_test_before_after.py` from `before_after_pooled.csv` and `before_after_by_entry_time.csv`; every number below is read from them.*

Before = the committed run (`results/linear_subsection_restofday/trading_test/`, tables fitted with the twelve session-edge columns; re-run on the pre-dedup snapshot for its per-day series). After = this folder (`yhat_restofday_*` rebuilt by I6, `yhat_sub_*` by I1). Same ledger, days, bars, fills and hedge; only the forecasts differ. Change = after - before, paired 95 % interval (circular block bootstrap, the test's own draws).
